name: Fractera Data
shortDescription: The database of the node: tables any element keeps through one door, the deploy journal, the agent-to-agent log, the panel settings and one route to the services of this machine.
longDescription: The database layer of the node. Elements never open a database file: they read and write tables through /db/tables (rows, one-row edits, inserts) with the node data key, and only the machine key may change the schema through /db/migrate. Next to the tables it keeps the deploy journal (/deploy-runs), the agent-to-agent conversation log (/a2a-log), the settings a control surface stores (/panel-settings), the one door for the OpenAI key (/platform/openai-key) and one route to the loopback services of the machine (/service/<name>/*). Media and vectors moved to their own elements (storage and vectors); their former addresses here still answer by passing the request on.
accepts: The node data key (X-Data-Secret) or a privileged session; JSON bodies.
returns: JSON: tables, rows, journal entries; the answers of the storage and vector elements unchanged on the former addresses /media and /vectors.
